messages.author: 389d046fc2d602cf
messages.subject: Error with node.label when check_BioGeoBEARS_run()
parts:
Hi Nick/All,

I am trying my first BioGeoBEARS analysis. I have a dated tree and a geography file whose terminal names are exactly the same. But after setting the run options, I am running the check_BioGeoBEARS_run() on my run object and getting the following error:

Error in if (tp[3] != "") obj$node.label <- tp[3] : missing value where TRUE/FALSE needed

I thought it was a problem with the labels, but they do match.

Any ideas about what I should try/check?

Thank you!

messages.author: 115d05260b0c341a
messages.subject: Re: [BioGeoBEARS] Error with node.label when check_BioGeoBEARS_run()
parts:
Hi -- that looks like something internal to the APE phylogeny object.

Searching my hard drive -- I see that error came up once when I tried to read a NEXUS-format phylogeny via read.tree().

So, if it's a NEXUS-format phylogeny, read it in with FigTree or read.nexus(), and then save out to a Newick file with FigTree or with write.tree().  Then use that Newick file as the input for BioGeoBEARS.

Cheers!
Nick
